GTA 6 Easter Eggs

Reported Easter eggs and references, each with its source and a spoiler-safe teaser.

29 sourced guides. Positions are deliberately unpinned until coordinate evidence is reliable — each guide gives the area and the source's own directions.

Belville conspiracy houseAn old image has a familiar counterpart. Trinity Apartments referenceA television reference waits on an island. Vespucci garage film referenceCheck a garage for a cinema-inspired car. Little Sam cameoOne quiet introduction may look familiar. Painted tower eggThe name of this secret is unusually literal. Skunk Ape SightingSomething big and hairy has been feeding in the swamp south of the lake. The Skunk Ape Hunt (Kirk's Flyer)A hunter's flyer in a Hamlet bar starts a hunt for something that may not want to be found. Michael's BoatThe boat parked at Jason's place looks like it had a previous owner in Los Santos. Arthur Morgan's HatA familiar cowboy hat is going cheap at a yard sale in Port Gellhorn. UFO Abduction at the Starlet MotelDrivers have seen strange lights in the woods east of Port Gellhorn, very late at night. Satan at the Circles of Hell HouseOne house in Port Gellhorn has a reputation nobody in town will explain. The Vice City PortalA chain of substations hums with power that points somewhere out of time. Hidden Radio Stations (WAiNK Posters)Some posters around Leonida are worth a closer scan than others. Sniper of La Perle Posters (Kodak Black)A local rapper's radio show only exists if you go looking for its posters. Cool Dog, the Jet Ski DogSwimmers who get stranded far from shore sometimes get a very unusual rescue. The Giant Crab of Pelican ValleyAn abandoned research station in the marsh still has something living in it. The Capri Warehouse RitualA warehouse in northern Capri has a circle on the floor that someone used for dark purposes. The Immortal Man of Key LentoOne man in Key Lento does not seem worried about snipers. At all. Tootsie the CowA farmer near Ambrosia is chasing a cow that has something to say. The Clown in the ElevatorAfter midnight, one elevator in an Ocean Beach building is best avoided. The Mario Block at the Paper MillSomething in the ruined paper mill rewards players who think in platforms. The Ghostbusters CarA Halloween-decorated house in Capri keeps a very familiar wagon parked outside. The ASS MAN PlateOne impounded car in Hamlet carries a plate Seinfeld fans will recognize. Lethal by Design: A Liberty City MemoirJason keeps a memoir on the table that Liberty City readers will appreciate. The Glowing Meteorite on Mount KalagaSomething fell on Mount Kalaga, and it glows after dark. The Cowboy's Prayer Is to Die YoungA Western novel on a marina office shelf tells a very familiar story. The New Austin Novel at Jacob's TavernA tavern in Millport stocks reading material from out west, way out west. The Developers' Memorial North of HamletA quiet memorial north of Hamlet carries real names from the people who built Leonida. The Race and Chase 7 PostA social media post on your phone complains about a very long wait for a sequel.

Leonida Fieldnotes is an independent, unofficial fan companion for Grand Theft Auto VI. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Every guide is sourced from a published report and labelled with its confidence tier; nothing here is presented as personally verified in-game, and no position is pinned without reliable coordinate evidence.
